name: ANU2023-Hex
author: Aeylindra
description:
Born from a (healthy) fear of Unity Physics and 3D graphics, comes a thrilling adventure of spell-casting, card drawing and hexagonally-themed interior decoration. We follow the adventures of the wizard Riley as they fight monsters, squish bugs* and seek ultimate power. Good luck... you're going to need it.

Supported Platforms
- Mouse
- (Unofficially touchscreen)
- Bonus points^ for finding the 2 keyboard shortcuts

ANU 2023 S2 COMP3540 Game Project: Group 42

* Please don't find any more bugs
^ Brownie points only
